scenes.goal: Establish dispatch counts and packaging baseline.
scenes.obstacle: Several workstreams are already using the same packing table.

scenes.exit: A provisional dispatch board exists with explicit destination groups.

scenes.goal: Identify why two allergy-meal bundles have questionable labels.
scenes.obstacle: Printer timestamp and manual packing log differ by seven minutes.
scenes.turn: C03 recognizes that visible meal appearance cannot resolve identity.
scenes.exit: Two bundles are marked suspect pending trace-back.

scenes.goal: Prevent suspect bundles from entering normal dispatch flow.
scenes.obstacle: Packing staff want to keep the table moving.
scenes.turn: C03 moves the suspect bundles into a dedicated hold category tied to trace-back records.
scenes.exit: Allergy uncertainty is physically separated from routine packaging at the semantic-plan level.

scenes.goal: Respond to volunteer offers to stay beyond scheduled prep.
scenes.obstacle: Packaging backlog makes extra hands attractive.
scenes.turn: C06 distinguishes voluntary low-risk help from contracted heavy loading work.
scenes.exit: Volunteer scope is recognized as a decision requiring explicit boundaries.

scenes.goal: Absorb the first two uncertainties into the evening plan.
scenes.obstacle: C01 cannot yet know when allergy bundles will clear or how much volunteer help is legal.
scenes.turn: C01 leaves those states unresolved but named instead of collapsing them into generic delay.
scenes.exit: Schedule slack narrows while ownership remains separated.

scenes.goal: Check cooling status of the early-route chicken containers.
scenes.obstacle: Chiller display and independent probe readings disagree.
scenes.turn: C02 requires container-level measurements instead of accepting the equipment display alone.
scenes.exit: A targeted recheck begins.

scenes.goal: Determine the scope of the cooling anomaly.
scenes.obstacle: Only two containers remain above the expected cooling trajectory.
scenes.turn: C02 separates suspect containers from the rest of the batch.
scenes.exit: Normal containers retain potential eligibility; suspect containers enter hold.

scenes.goal: Provide C01 a usable planning state.
scenes.obstacle: C01 asks for a release time C02 cannot honestly promise.
scenes.turn: C02 gives conditions and next-measurement time instead of a guaranteed completion time.
scenes.exit: Planning must use conditional states.

scenes.goal: Define safe hold and release criteria.
scenes.obstacle: Keeping the containers too long can also disrupt quality and route timing.
scenes.turn: C02 freezes repeat-measure interval, release threshold and discard boundary.
scenes.exit: E01 decision ownership is explicit under C02.

scenes.goal: Reflect cooling uncertainty in dispatch planning.
scenes.obstacle: First-wave quantities may drop.
scenes.turn: C01 marks suspect containers as conditional rather than pushing C02 to clear them.
scenes.exit: The dispatch board now represents safety state without changing owner.

scenes.goal: Begin transfer of the porridge-consistency method to the replacement cook.
scenes.obstacle: Written recipe values do not encode the later hold-thickening behavior.
scenes.turn: C04 frames the task around observable state over time rather than a fixed final number.
scenes.exit: The replacement cook has a first observation target.

scenes.goal: Define a reproducible early consistency checkpoint.
scenes.obstacle: The same ladle measure can look different before and after hold.
scenes.turn: C04 identifies a time-linked texture response and C03 records the checkpoint.
scenes.exit: Tacit skill gains one repeatable observation point.

scenes.goal: Test how the sample changes during holding.
scenes.obstacle: The replacement cook assumes the initial consistency should remain fixed.
scenes.turn: C04 distinguishes expected thickening from a failure trajectory.
scenes.exit: A second observation point and failure direction are defined.

scenes.goal: Set the boundary for correction.
scenes.obstacle: Late water addition can mask an earlier process error.
scenes.turn: C04 defines when correction is still allowed and when the batch must be escalated instead.
scenes.exit: The method now includes a non-recoverable boundary.

scenes.goal: Have the replacement cook restate and apply the method.
scenes.obstacle: Memorizing words is not evidence of repeatability.
scenes.turn: The replacement cook applies the checkpoints to a fresh sample while C04 withholds direct completion of the task.
scenes.exit: A provisional transfer exists for later verification.

scenes.goal: Begin trace-back of suspect allergy bundles.
scenes.obstacle: Printer time cannot be trusted as a single source.
scenes.turn: C03 combines tray sequence, ingredient log and packing order as independent evidence.
scenes.exit: Trace-back path is defined.

scenes.goal: Use volunteers without transferring allergy responsibility.
scenes.obstacle: Volunteers can help compare records but cannot make final identity decisions.
scenes.turn: C06 limits volunteer work to low-risk cross-checking while C03 retains release authority.
scenes.exit: Bounded assistance begins without owner mutation.

scenes.goal: Respond to a request for volunteers to move heavy delivery crates.
scenes.obstacle: Paid staff are occupied by trace-back and cooling work.
scenes.turn: C06 refuses to expand volunteer scope into heavy loading and identifies the task as staff-owned.
scenes.exit: Labor boundary becomes operational rather than rhetorical.

scenes.goal: Reallocate paid staff under the volunteer boundary.
scenes.obstacle: Keeping heavy work paid creates a real staffing shortage.
scenes.turn: C01 accepts slower packing instead of asking C06 to relax the boundary.
scenes.exit: Schedule pressure increases while labor ownership remains intact.

scenes.goal: Set volunteer stop time and remaining tasks.
scenes.obstacle: Volunteers want to stay until everything is done.
scenes.turn: C06 defines a fixed stop time and a limited final task list.
scenes.exit: E04 has a concrete boundary for later enforcement.

scenes.goal: Receive the route-change notice.
scenes.obstacle: One district becomes inaccessible after 06:40 because of roadwork.
scenes.turn: C05 identifies the notice as a dispatch constraint rather than a reason to bypass checks.
scenes.exit: The original single-wave plan is no longer viable.

scenes.goal: Calculate what can actually leave before 06:40.
scenes.obstacle: Cooling and allergy holds are unresolved.
scenes.turn: C05 separates verified items from conditional items before considering vehicle capacity.
scenes.exit: A candidate first-wave list exists.

scenes.goal: Create a follow-up route for held items.
scenes.obstacle: Recipients expect complete deliveries.
scenes.turn: C05 creates a second-wave manifest with named held categories rather than a vague remainder.
scenes.exit: Two-wave logistics is established.

scenes.goal: Align recipient counts with the two-wave plan.
scenes.obstacle: Some destinations have mixed normal and allergy-specific meals.
scenes.turn: C03 marks which destination groups cannot be split across uncertain identity states.
scenes.exit: Manifest logic respects allergy grouping.

scenes.goal: Freeze first-wave seal and loading times.
scenes.obstacle: Late releases could tempt last-minute untracked additions.
scenes.turn: C05 sets a manifest freeze time and requires any later release to move to the follow-up wave.
scenes.exit: E05 owner and handoff rule are explicit.

scenes.goal: Run the first scheduled cooling recheck.
scenes.obstacle: One suspect container improves while the other remains outside release trajectory.
scenes.turn: C02 releases only the qualifying container and keeps the other on hold.
scenes.exit: Container-level decision prevents all-or-nothing batch logic.

scenes.goal: Resolve as much of the label trace-back as evidence allows.
scenes.obstacle: Most bundles can be traced but one subgroup still has an ambiguous handoff moment.
scenes.turn: C03 releases verified bundles and keeps the ambiguous subgroup isolated.
scenes.exit: Allergy state is partially resolved without guesswork.

scenes.goal: Update both dispatch manifests after safety and identity decisions.
scenes.obstacle: Quantities changed in opposite directions across destinations.
scenes.turn: C05 revises vehicle counts while preserving C02/C03 decisions verbatim.
scenes.exit: Logistics adapts without semantic override.

scenes.goal: Prevent released items from being mixed back with unresolved ones.
scenes.obstacle: Workers are consolidating space as the night shift progresses.
scenes.turn: C01 keeps the first-wave and follow-up states separately represented on the operating board.
scenes.exit: Operational compression does not erase state distinctions.

scenes.goal: Create a named unresolved-items handoff for the next work block.
scenes.obstacle: Fatigue encourages generic notes like 'check later'.
scenes.turn: C01 requires each unresolved item to carry owner, next check and release condition.
scenes.exit: The overnight remainder is explicit and distributed.

scenes.goal: Verify the porridge method after a realistic hold interval.
scenes.obstacle: Texture has changed since the earlier sample.
scenes.turn: The replacement cook uses the recorded observation points before asking C04 for confirmation.
scenes.exit: The transfer is tested under delayed conditions.

scenes.goal: Have the replacement cook choose whether correction is still allowed.
scenes.obstacle: The sample is near the correction boundary.
scenes.turn: The replacement cook identifies the boundary using the transferred failure signs.
scenes.exit: Repeatability improves without C04 taking over.

scenes.goal: Complete the first transfer check.
scenes.obstacle: C04 sees a minor deviation she could fix faster herself.
scenes.turn: C04 intervenes only to point to the predefined signal, leaving execution to the replacement cook.
scenes.exit: The method remains teachable rather than person-dependent.

scenes.goal: Enforce the volunteer stop time.
scenes.obstacle: Remaining packaging makes continued help tempting.
scenes.turn: C06 ends volunteer work at the declared time and transfers unfinished tasks back to staff.
scenes.exit: Volunteer boundary survives real pressure.

scenes.goal: Redistribute staff tasks after volunteers leave.
scenes.obstacle: Packing, washing and loading remain incomplete.
scenes.turn: C01 reorganizes staff assignments without reopening volunteer scope.
scenes.exit: Remaining workload is explicitly staff-owned.

scenes.goal: Receive the advanced fire-door/egress test notice.
scenes.obstacle: The test now overlaps first-wave staging and wash-return traffic.
scenes.turn: C01 treats the corridor as a protected shared constraint rather than another storage variable.
scenes.exit: E06 enters the overnight plan.

scenes.goal: Map all current uses of the affected corridor.
scenes.obstacle: Dispatch carts, empty insulated boxes and wash returns occupy different parts of the same route.
scenes.turn: Each owner states the time window they truly need instead of claiming the corridor continuously.
scenes.exit: Hard and movable spatial needs are distinguished.

scenes.goal: Build a time-phased corridor plan.
scenes.obstacle: Moving everything to one temporary area would recreate blockage elsewhere.
scenes.turn: C01 reserves the egress route and assigns non-egress staging by time block.
scenes.exit: Spatial coordination is defined without taking over task ownership.

scenes.goal: Move first-wave staging out of the protected corridor.
scenes.obstacle: The alternate zone is smaller and requires manifest-order staging.
scenes.turn: C05 reorganizes first-wave carts according to the sealed loading order.
scenes.exit: Dispatch staging and egress protection become compatible.

scenes.goal: Test the time-phased route before the morning rush.
scenes.obstacle: Wash-return traffic arrives during the rehearsal window.
scenes.turn: C01 adjusts only the collision interval while preserving each owner's constraints.
scenes.exit: A workable shared-space schedule is ready for morning execution.

scenes.goal: Make the final cooling decision for first-wave eligibility.
scenes.obstacle: The remaining held container reaches its last planned recheck.
scenes.turn: C02 applies the frozen release/discard condition without changing it for schedule reasons.
scenes.exit: Cooling state is final for first-wave manifest purposes.

scenes.goal: Close the overnight allergy trace-back for first-wave purposes.
scenes.obstacle: One ambiguous subgroup may still lack complete evidence.
scenes.turn: C03 releases only fully traceable bundles and assigns unresolved ones to follow-up handling.
scenes.exit: First-wave allergy state is final without guesswork.

scenes.goal: Verify the porridge method under final morning hold conditions.
scenes.obstacle: The production batch has a longer hold than the training samples.
scenes.turn: The replacement cook applies the transferred checkpoints and C04 confirms the method rather than personally reworking the batch.

scenes.obstacle: Safety, allergy and quantity changes have accumulated overnight.

scenes.exit: First-wave contents are fixed and accountable.

scenes.goal: Load the first vehicle according to the frozen manifest.

scenes.exit: Vehicle is ready before cutoff with state integrity preserved.

scenes.obstacle: A final request arrives to add a newly available follow-up item.
scenes.turn: C05 refuses post-freeze addition and leaves it for the next wave.
scenes.exit: First vehicle departs on the sealed manifest.

scenes.goal: Complete the fire-door and egress test without derailing kitchen handoff.
scenes.obstacle: Morning wash and cart traffic is beginning.
scenes.turn: C01 executes the time-phased corridor plan and coordinates only the shared collision points.
scenes.exit: Facility test completes with owner roles intact.

scenes.obstacle: Morning staff could inherit a generic unresolved pile.
scenes.turn: C02, C03 and C05 hand off named conditions, next checks and manifest responsibilities separately.

scenes.obstacle: Several follow-up obligations remain unfinished by design.
